topic: L2 audit hash chain close-out (Option C): full-chain verification, decision record, thread archive
outcome: Closed out L2 audit hash chain under the owner's Option (c) directive: no historical backfill; verification changed from a bounded 2000-row window to complete coverage of the entire post-deployment sealed chain via a resumable background sweep (one canonical migrationRuns row, 500-row batches chained by scheduler, hourly cron re-running from genesis). getAuditChainHealth now reads run status/coverage; the Audit log UI shows when the last full sweep completed and the exact chain range covered. Explicit decision recorded in decisions.md (2026-09-15, PR #17). Full gate green: typecheck 0, lint 0, tokens:check green, tests 154/154, build green. PR #17 held for personal review - no self-merge.
decisions: Option (c) - new chain from deployment: chain starts at the first post-deployment audit row (genesis sentinel mylesnet:audit-chain:v1:genesis); pre-deployment rows remain readable but are intentionally unsealed and outside the chain. No backfill built.

No-backfill rationale: a hash computed now cannot prove pre-backfill rows were unmodified before hashing, so backfilling offers no stronger real-world integrity guarantee and would put rewrite tooling inside an append-only log.
Verification coverage must be complete, not windowed - the previous newest-2000 window is not a permanent ceiling.

Verification architecture: background sweep (convex/auditChainVerify.ts) advancing one bounded 500-row batch per internal mutation, resumable via canonical migrationRuns run 'audit-chain-verify-001', hourly cron re-ran from genesis for rolling full coverage; platform:getAuditChainHealth reads only the stored run status/coverage.
Chain semantics unchanged: sealing, canonical payload, and chainSequence behavior stay approved as-is (146/146 baseline + 8 new pure-core cases).
Hold for personal review: PR #17 (myles/platform-audit-hash-chain -> main) is not self-merged.
openQuestions: Manual npx convex run of the sweep in the live environment to verify the production chain end-to-end before merge.
